About

Wholeness
without erasure.

Our experiences do not need to be hidden for us to become whole. The marks of change, struggle and repair are part of the story—and often part of what makes it meaningful.

Who We Are

Fragments
made whole

Fragments Made Whole is an inclusive gallery and creative community built around authentic expression, connection and the belief that what has been broken does not need to be hidden.

The gallery gives artists room to create, exhibit, teach and sell their work while welcoming people who have felt overlooked, out of place or unheard.

Still Beating extends that purpose through coffee, conversation and everyday gathering—a place to pause, connect and continue growing.

01

Mission

To provide a welcoming, professionally run space where artists and community members can create, share, gather and find their voices.

02

Vision

A creative community where authentic expression is protected, difference is valued and people can build belonging through art and connection.

03

Brand Promise

Every person, artwork and interaction will be met with care, clarity and respect.

Our Values

What we
stand for

Our values shape the art we support, the community we welcome and the way we follow through.

They guide both the public experience and the everyday operation of Fragments Made Whole and Still Beating.

01

Authentic Expression

We make room for honest work and real voices without asking people to smooth away what makes them different.

02

Belonging

We welcome people who have felt overlooked, out of place or unheard and create opportunities for meaningful connection.

03

Courageous Creativity

We support art that is challenging, personal and alive. Hate and sexual violence have no place in the community we are building.

04

Growth and Repair

We do not hide the broken places. We honor the ways experience, repair and growth become part of who we are.

05

Care and Follow-Through

We communicate clearly, stay organized and treat artists, visitors and their work with consideration and respect.

You can’t use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.— Maya Angelou

Founder

Karen Aldrich

Karen Aldrich is the founder of Fragments Made Whole Gallery and Still Beating Café.

After building and eventually selling a successful dog-grooming business, Karen set her sights on creating a new kind of space—one where artists feel free to be themselves, share their most authentic work and find genuine community.

Her experience as a business owner shapes her commitment to clear communication, thoughtful organization and following through for the artists and people she serves. Having faced significant adversity in her own life, Karen believes our difficult experiences do not need to be hidden. They can become part of how we grow, reconnect and build something meaningful.

Through Fragments Made Whole and Still Beating, Karen hopes to create a welcoming place for people who have felt overlooked, out of place or unheard—a place to create, gather and find their voices. Outside of her work, she especially values spending time with her son, Miles.
